description: Event ingestion requests to the Mixpanel track endpoint, which posts a bare array of events. /import is vendor/mixpanel-import. /engage is vendor/mixpanel-engage. /groups is vendor/mixpanel-groups.

params.name: event
params.description: Mixpanel documents the event name as required.
params.fix_hint: Name the event, such as `Signed Up`.

params.name: properties
params.description: Mixpanel documents the properties object as required, since the project token rides inside it.
params.fix_hint: Add a `properties` object carrying at least `token`.

params.name: properties.token
params.description: It is the project token the event is attributed to.
params.fix_hint: Send the project token from your Mixpanel project settings.

params.name: properties.distinct_id
params.description: It identifies the user who performed the event. Mixpanel documents it as the unique user identifier; without it the event is not tied to a person.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `distinct_id` you use elsewhere for this user.

params.name: properties.time
params.description: Mixpanel documents `time` as a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds. A non-numeric value is not that format.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds or milliseconds since epoch, as an integer.

params.name: properties.$insert_id
params.description: Mixpanel uses it to drop duplicates, so a retried request is not counted twice. `/import` requires it in vendor/mixpanel-import.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable id per event.
